text: Stigmergy, first described in termite nest construction, refers to:
choices: A hierarchical command structure in which a queen directly instructs each worker
Indirect coordination in which an agent's modification of the environment influences the subsequent actions of other agents
The genetic program that determines an insect's adult body plan
Direct synaptic signaling between two adjacent neurons
explanation: Stigmergy is coordination through the environment: one agent's action changes the environment in a way that shapes what other agents do next. It is the mechanism behind ant-colony, mycelial, and biofilm problem-solving without central control, and it inspired ant colony optimization. It is not top-down command, genetics, or neuron-to-neuron signaling.
